## What's new

- **Type over placeholders.** Click "Central topic" in a new tab, or any "New idea", and just type. Double-click and F2 select the whole text, and typing on a selected node replaces its text, like a spreadsheet cell.
- **Duplicate tabs.** Right-click a tab to duplicate or close it.
- **Settings behind a gear icon** at the top right: theme cards, presentation options and general options in one place. The toolbar is slimmer.
- **Softer slides.** Slides and pictures in the presentation get a soft, blurred shadow.
- **Title slide options.** The topic tags on the title slide can be switched off (Settings → Topics on the title slide).
- **Phone remote:** the small web server now shuts down when the presentation ends.

## Download

- `Mindful-macos-arm64.zip`: macOS 11 or newer on Apple silicon (M1 and newer)
- `Mindful-windows-x64.zip`: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit

**macOS:** Mindful isn't notarized by Apple yet. After the first launch attempt, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**. Alternatively, run:

```
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Mindful.app
```

**Windows:** unzip and start `Mindful.exe`. There is no installer. SmartScreen warns on the first start: click **More info → Run anyway**.
